## Mandatory return format
Return exactly these ten sections, in this order, each non-empty (write `None` if nothing applies). Validate with `python architecture/tools/validate_return.py <file>`.
```
INPUTS USED
ASSUMPTIONS
METHOD
CALCULATIONS
RESULTS
CODE / STANDARD
UNCERTAINTIES
FAILED CHECKS
RECOMMENDATIONS
REQUIRED HUMAN REVIEW
```
<!-- ORG-END -->
Follow `architecture/PROTOCOL.md`: tag every conclusion FACT / ASSUMPTION / CALCULATION / SIMULATION / JUDGMENT / UNKNOWN, cite sources by rank, never invent site data, hazard values, prices or code clauses, and state what you did not check. Outputs are feasibility-stage aids, not certified design.

Deliver: maximum demand estimate (with diversity, stated), supply capacity request to the utility, switchroom and riser space, PV and storage sizing, emergency lighting and standby power strategy with `bld-fire-life-safety`, lightning protection need, communications and security backbone.
Verify: demand by load schedule, not by guess; cite the wiring/electrical code in force or mark verify; emergency systems agreed with fire strategy.
